_note: All gameplay and presentation numbers. Edit and reload the page (F5) to apply. Coins = TikTok coin value of a gift.

round._finale: finaleSec = last seconds of a round in which everything counts finaleMult times (0 = off, the default; the round timer and the "Son 30 saniye" status line show regardless).

teams._switch: A member typing another city (the whole message is the place): switches when they sent no gift this round (or the round is over) and switchCooldownSec passed since they joined / last switched (-1 = never). Otherwise a reply 'Zaten İzmir'desin' (once per replyCooldownSec); a gifter also reads 'yeni turda değiştirebilirsin'.

troops._giftCurve: Troops for ONE gift by its coin value: [coins, troops] points, interpolated on a log-log scale (extrapolated with the last slope). Combos: troops x count. Finale multiplier on top. Siege damage = troops x tier.siegeTroopShare.
troops._followBonus: Troops for following the streamer. 0 (default) = a follow gives nothing and shows nothing on screen. TikTok may restrict streams that reward engagement; see README (TikTok kuralları).
troops._shareBonus: Troops for sharing the stream. 0 = sharing gives nothing and shows nothing on screen (no floater, no credit).
troops._crowd: Crowd bonus: passivePerSqrtMemberPerSec x sqrt(members) troops per second (1 member 0.25/s, 100 members 2.5/s, 300 members 4.3/s).

engage._note: Zero-effort actions. Bare plate/city message joins. Engagement rewards (chatTroops, likesPerTroop, troops.followBonus, troops.shareBonus) are 0 by default: TikTok may restrict streams that reward chat, likes, follows or shares (README: TikTok kuralları); the panel can switch them back on. With chatTroops > 0 any member chat = chatTroops (once per chatCooldownSec per viewer). Comeback: a team with no province, or at most comebackShare of the leader's provinces (leader >= comebackMinLead), gets likes and chat x comebackMult. 1-coin gifts march as a named soldier (paradeMax at once).
engage._caps: Free troops per viewer per round, on the final count (after finale/comeback multipliers): chatTroopCap from chat, likeTroopCap from likes (0 = no cap). Past a cap the viewer gets one note per round (freeCapNudgeGapSec stream-wide); likes keep filling the HÜCUM bar without any cap.
engage._likes: Likes always fill the HÜCUM morale bar. likesPerTroop 0 (default) = likes give no troops and the screen shows no like counts, floaters or exchange rate; only a rate-limited neutral name pop ("Ahmet · hücumu dolduruyor", likeNameGapNoRewardSec between pops). With likesPerTroop > 0: every likesPerTroop likes from a member = +1 troop at their province (finale and comeback multiply), shown as one floater per likeBatchSec per viewer. likeMilestone = name pop at the province every N likes in the round (likeNameGapSec between pops, stream-wide). Likes from viewers who have not joined are held (up to pendingLikesMax) and credited on join; they get a hint (likeHintGapSec stream-wide, likeHintPerUserSec per viewer).
engage._likeLimit: Anti auto-clicker: per viewer at most likeMaxPerSec likes per second count (bursts up to likeBurst); the rest count for nothing (HÜCUM morale, likers board). 0 = no limit.

gifts._note: Gift ladder by the coin value of ONE gift (highest matching minCoins wins; unlisted gifts fall to the nearest lower step). Troops per gift come from troops.giftCurve; the step sets the spectacle (units, figures, siege, announce, camera). rank 0-4 = spectacle class (sound, credit length, callouts, camera). legend = short effect word for the gift strip; does = one short sentence for the panel's gift table (Turkish).

morale._rate: Need x max(1, likeRate/likeRateRef)^likeRateExp (likeRate = stream-wide likes per second). oneAtATime: a full bar waits while another city charges.

war._note: Pace: attackIntervalSec per team, captureShieldSec = a fresh capture is hard to retake (freshDefenseMult) and the AI leaves it alone, so a province changes hands at most about every 20-30 s.
war._strength: Strength scales into action. surplus = troops above every province's reserve. frontTroops: each doubling of surplus over it opens one more simultaneous front (up to maxFronts) and shortens the attack interval (x (frontTroops/surplus)^0.35, floor minIntervalMult); ordinary teams (surplus <= frontTroops) keep one front and the base interval. Extra fronts need send x power >= weakness x extraFrontRatio, armies are sized to weakness x attackMargin, departures staggered by staggerSec, at most maxArmiesPerTeam armies per team. When the chosen target cannot be afforded the weakest affordable one is attacked instead, so troops never sit idle in one garrison.
war._momentum: After a won battle (or reaching an own province) an attack/gift army keeps max(momentumHoldMin, troops x momentumHoldShare, the strongest adjacent enemy garrison x momentumHoldThreat, the province's reserve) there and the rest marches on after momentumPauseSec to the weakest adjacent target it beats by momentumRatio, if at least momentumMin troops are left; it forks into one more branch per momentumSplitTroops it carries (at most 3 per hop, 0 = never). momentum false = off.
war._defence: Reserves: every province keeps keepAtHome plus incoming enemy attack x defendMargin / its defence bonus; the capital also keeps adjacent enemy garrisons x capitalThreatShare / bonus and capitalReserveShare of the team's total troops. Every defendCheckSec a threatened capital recalls armies that just left it and pulls spare troops from adjacent provinces. Big gifts first fill a thin capital (at most giftHomeShare of the gift). A shielded province bounces armies below shieldBreakRatio x its defence; shieldBounceKeep of the bounced army walks home.

visual._lod: Below lodZoom figures are low-poly tokens (cheap); zoomed in, up to maxFiguresDetailed use the animated models, the rest tokens.
visual._streamTiltDeg: Stream layout only: camera tilt (the full layout keeps tiltDeg). Larger = more from the side, so Turkey fills the short, wide stream band wider. hud.streamMapInset / hud.streamMapFitY: how far below the band top the map starts (0 = under the imperative pill) and the share of the band height it may fill.
visual._streamMapStretch: Stream layout only: north-south stretch of the map (1 = true proportions; mapStretch is the full layout's).
visual._streamMaxFps: Stream layout only: frames drawn per second (TikTok LIVE sends 30; drawing more only loads the streaming PC). 0 = no cap. ?fps=N overrides it. maxRenderPixels caps the canvas size (default the 1080x1920 frame).

director._note: Overview is the default. Zooms only for top-two-tier gifts, a capital falling and the last seconds. minGapSec = overview time between zooms; easeSec = slow move in/out.

hud._note: Rate limits: feedMinGapSec between feed lines (queued, feedQueueMax kept), calloutMinGapSec between big centre callouts; credit*Sec = how long a gift credit stays.
hud._giftStrip: Gift ladder under the map (cheapest first; up to 16): name as viewers see it in the TikTok app (may be empty: the tile shows the coin value, plus=true adds +), coins, effect word. Each tile reads name · coins -> +N asker (N from troops.giftCurve, live) + effect. Effects come from the coin value (gifts.tiers), never from the name. id = TikTok gift id, only when verified from a real gift event (Rose = 5655); entries without one are matched to TikTok gifts by name (Turkish or English, game/js/gift-names.js) at the same coin value. A nameless entry takes the name and picture of the gift viewers most recently sent at exactly its price (bridge catalogue, seen); until then the tile shows the price. giftStripPageSec = seconds per page; giftStripTroops=false hides the +N.
hud._tiktokZones: Design units on the 1080x1920 stage that TikTok LIVE covers: top header height, chat (y >= chatTop, x <= chatRight), bottom bar height, right hearts/gift column (x >= rightColLeft, y >= rightColTop). The stream layout keeps everything between top and chatTop and left of rightColLeft below rightColTop. side = units at the left and right edge that phones taller than 9:16 crop (the stream is scaled to fill the screen height); stream blocks and the map stay inside them. ?zones=1 draws them. chatTop and side are also streamer settings (panel Ekran: layout.chatTop, layout.side).
hud._giftStripStream: Stream layout: big ladder tiles, giftStripPageSizeStream per page, giftStripPageSecStream seconds per page; giftHeading = the descriptive tab over the ladder (panel: gifts.heading).
